support.quote: ### New features * Support converting UMT5 models from Hugging Face Transformers (#2103) by [@the-cross-art](https://github.com/the-cross-art) ### Fixes and improvements * Support Transformer models where each layer has its own relative attention bias by [@the-cross-art](https://github.com/the-cross-art) * Fix Windows ROCm Translator hangs and DLL loading (#2106) by [@0xDELUXA](https://github.com/0xDELUXA) * Fix crashes when loading model files from Python file-like objects (#2110) by [@Purfview](https://github.com/Purfview) * Upgrade pybind11 to 2.13.6 for CPython 3.14 allocator safety (#2108) by [@cepeter](https://github.com/cepeter) * Guard exhausted candidates in CUDA TopK stage 2 (#2104) by [@mzggr0914](https://github.com/mzggr0914) * Fix Windows shutdown deadlocks and memory leaks with the Ruy backend (#2076) by [@timo9378](https://github.com/timo9378) * Add Clang ThreadSanitizer testing (#1986) by [@3manifold](https://github.com/3manifold) * Improve ROCm wheel testing and release checks; upgrade build actions to Node.js 24 (#2112) by [@jordimas](https://github.com/jordimas) * Add local CUDA and ROCm release validation with CI wheels and commit status reporting by [@jordimas](https://github.com/jordimas)
